messages:
sara: heads up — perf CI flagged a ~30% token/sec regression on the INT8 profile after the 2:10pm release. stack: runtime + quant path.
ci-bot: [CI] perf-check-int8 (build #4521) failed: throughput drop exceeded threshold (baseline 12.8k -> 8.9k tokens/sec). See artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/4521/artifacts
ben: ack. noticed noisy jiggles earlier in canary but assumed noise. can you paste the perf artifacts?
sara: attaching main flame output (trimmed):
```
flamegraph: hot: dequant_kernel_dispatch -> fused_attn_kernel -> dequant_copy
50% time in dequant_kernel_dispatch
20% in kv_cache_miss_path
```
rui: interesting — dequant_kernel_dispatch was introduced in my PR that switched kernel selection to prefer fused dequant kernels for INT8/4-bit. maybe that path is slower on 80/90 token sequences.
maria: also saw increased short-batch rate in the traces. batching heuristic seems to be producing more small batches after the change. could be compounding the issue.
ben: can we bisect to the exact merge? start by testing commit range: 
```
git bisect start HEAD v2026-03-10
git bisect run ./tools/perf/run_int8_bench.sh --samples 50
```
jake: I did a quick bisect on my laptop — bisect points to merged PR #2894 (kernel-selector: prefer-fused-dequant). reverting locally brings throughput back to ~12k.
sara: good repro. what's different in fused path? wasm logs show extra copy when KV cache is a miss: fused path does dequant -> copy -> fused-attn, whereas old path used in-place dequant + streaming KV reuse.
rui: oof — I naively added a `dequant_buffer` because the fused kernels expect `uint8_t*` aligned layout. missed a fastpath for KV-backed in-place dequant.
maria: two mitigations: 1) short-term revert of kernel selector, 2) add KV in-place dequant fastpath and adjust batching heuristic to prefer merging short sequences for int8. which do we want?
ben: if this blocks rollouts, revert + hotfix is safest. we should also add a regression test in perf CI that runs representative KV-heavy traces (seq len distribution).
sara: agreed. create revert PR and open follow-up for fastpath + batching tweak. also add perf CI case that simulates small batch heavy KV misses.
jake: I'll open the revert now (WIP). PR title: "revert: prefer-fused-dequant kernel selector (perf regression)". tagging @rui for follow-up.
rui: sorry about regress — working on a minimal in-place path. will push patch by EOD with microbench numbers.
ben: also consider adding a heuristic: if KV-miss ratio > 10% use in-place kernel even if fused available. that would avoid perf cliff for cold caches.
maria: logging note: add metric to runtime payloads for `dequant_path` and `kv_hit` so we can correlate in prod.
ci-bot: [CI] created issue PERF-1227 for regression tracking.
sara: thanks everyone. once revert PR passes e2e and perf CI, we cut a canary and watch `int8_throughput` metric. :thumbsup:
jenkins-bot: deploy scheduled for canary 3:30pm -> will monitor 30m window.
sara: leaving this thread for updates.
